apps.name: Clearline
apps.subtitle: Private offline-first task management for iPhone and Windows.
apps.localizedDescription: Clearline is a private, offline-first task manager with native iPhone integrations, widgets and controls, Share Sheet capture, Shortcuts/App Intents, reminders, calendar interoperability, and encrypted cross-device synchronization.

versions.localizedDescription: Planner-derived Clearline iPhone physical-test candidate, build 4. Repairs the startup Room database-path regression by keeping the canonical planner.db in the main app sandbox, restores the Clearline AppIcon asset pipeline, preserves Widgets/Share projection architecture, and passed the full Codemagic build-4 validation and unsigned packaging lane.

Planner-derived Clearline iPhone physical-test candidate, build 3. Home/Settings/About refinement tranche plus configurable Things-style Clearline widgets, interactive completion, deep links, Progress/New To-Do surfaces and App Intent controls. Verified Codemagic candidate.

Planner-derived Clearline iPhone physical-test candidate, build 2. Repairs the physical launch crash by packaging Compose resources/fonts into the final iPhone app and keeps main app, Widgets and Share extension at one coherent version. Codemagic green through Kotlin/Native, Swift bridge, Xcode and SideStore packaging.

Planner-derived Clearline iPhone physical-test candidate, build 1. KMP/Compose + Room client with Clearline integration; Codemagic green through Kotlin/Native, Swift bridge, main app, Widgets, Share extension and unsigned SideStore packaging. Verified candidate SHA-256: 9fa292f067a434277ee8e82d029f3cb47611716a6dc931cc1f004662f74812d5.

Stable-origin physical-iPhone candidate, build 5. Built from dual-green source commit 8310155dca5e2322e9de71ec437619bf728877ff. Embedded Clearline is served through a native clearline-local WKURLSchemeHandler rather than file://; untouched Actions artifact provenance, 72/72 payload hashes, main web bundle, and both extensions were verified before publication.

Physical-iPhone startup diagnostic candidate, build 4. Built from dual-green source commit bee806d47fd535dda021835d8b796487dec63fbd. Includes one-time empty-startup reload and visible WKWebView/JavaScript diagnostics; compiled version/build, main web bundle, and both extensions passed remote and direct IPA verification.

Diagnostic physical-iPhone candidate, build 3. Built from dual-green source commit 12904d0080b9670b7324b7188595208bae374354. Includes one-time empty-startup reload plus visible WKWebView/JavaScript startup diagnostics; main web bundle and both extensions passed remote and direct IPA verification.

Web-embedded physical-iPhone retest candidate. Built from dual-green source commit e7e64d2101c7e04d90acc1faf8e05f7a104cce04. Main app www/index.html and compiled assets, Widgets/Controls metadata, and Share extension metadata all passed remote artifact gates and direct IPA inspection before publication.
